opening_message:
Ticket 1: Kimberly Dennis (employee ID E010) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E010.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Kimberly Dennis (E010) is a full_time Payroll Specialist. Requested admin to Source Code. Source Code is owned by Engineer, not Payroll Specialist, so admin is not allowed. Max for full_time without owning role is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Kimberly Dennis (E010) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Requested admin to Source Code, which exceeds max of read. Recommend read.
reason: HR note (authoritative for employment type) states Kimberly Dennis (E010) is a full_time Payroll Specialist. Source Code is owned by Engineer, not Payroll Specialist, so admin is not permitted for this employee; the maximum for a full_time employee who does not own the system is write. The requested level (admin) exceeds write, so the maximum (write) is granted. (Note: Security's claim of contractor status conflicts with HR; relying on HR for employment type.)
